### Relationships Between Modifications
The modifications in both files are related to the handling of D-Bus properties for system call filtering and address family restrictions. The changes in `bus-unit-util.c` focus on how these properties are constructed and sent over D-Bus, while the changes in `dbus-execute.c` ensure that the transient properties are set correctly in the execution context. Both files now utilize a string vector to manage the properties more effectively, improving memory management and error handling. The adjustments in `dbus-execute.c` also reflect a shift in focus from address families to syscall filters, aligning with the changes made in `bus-unit-util.c`. Overall, these modifications work together to fix bugs related to the D-Bus API, ensuring that properties are correctly formatted and handled.
